facts.name: Heather Beato
facts.assignment: Highlands administrative judge; Section10 Civil and Section18 Felony VOP/COMP, as listed on official profile.

contact.contact_note: Shared office/assistant number. Civil hearing room3B; jury courtroom2A. Personal judicial email or separate assistant-only telephone not established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion first; consult online civil calendar, coordinate all parties and email assistant case/motion details and agreed time/duration. Wait for confirmation before noticing; no UMC. Email cancellations and notice to office.

conferral.summary: General instructions invoke Rule1.202 conferral and certificate for non-dispositive motions; hearing times must be cleared with opposing parties or explain failed good-faith clearance.

proposed_orders.summary: Normally submit through e-portal/CAPS after filing underlying motion, with transmittal copied to opponents. SectionIV.A specifies paper delivery with copies/envelopes for garnishments, foreclosure judgments, specified foreclosure-sale orders, sealed-document orders and structured-settlement sales. Electronic orders use .docx and listed formatting; see linked instructions for exceptions and detail.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email motion and hearing notice to assistant at least five days before hearing. Orders submitted without hearing include filed motion copy; chambers submission does not itself file the motion.

remote_appearances.summary: Contested evidentiary hearings in person in3B; communicate appearance mode when scheduling. Approved virtual notice uses official Highlands Microsoft Teams courtroom3B link and ADA notice. No universal remote permission inferred.

chambers_communications.summary: Use assistant email for scheduling and office communications; proposed-order transmittal copies opponents. Instructions generally hold orders five working days for objections unless no-objection letter; notify office promptly of objections and follow linked written-submission instructions.

facts.summary: Civil calendar coordination and assistant confirmation; CAPS submissions with specified paper exceptions; emailed hearing materials and in-person contested evidentiary hearings. Limited practical office review.
